title: 533. Validate IP Address

examples.explanation: Four decimal groups, each 0-255 with no leading zeroes.
256 exceeds the largest allowed IPv4 group value of 255.

hints: Split on dots and on colons separately, keeping empty pieces so missing groups are caught.
IPv4 forbids leading zeroes and values above 255; IPv6 needs exactly 8 groups of 1-4 hex digits with no shorthand.
